b1-27-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Anna's Party
b1-27-01.scenario: Petra asks Meg how Anna's party went. You (Meg) say that Anna said she felt very good at the party and that the hosts were very kind.
b1-27-01.prompt: Tell Petra what Anna said about the party and what the hosts were like.
cues: Say what Anna said about how she felt
Say what the hosts were like
b1-27-01.target: Anna azt mondta, hogy nagyon jól érezte magát a bulin. A házigazdák nagyon kedvesek voltak.
b1-27-01.english: Anna said that she felt very good at the party. The hosts were very kind.
b1-27-01.canDo: I can report what someone said, with azt mondta, hogy ….

b1-27-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Question from a Colleague
b1-27-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg what her colleague wanted. You (Meg) say that the colleague asked whether you are going to the meeting.
b1-27-02.prompt: Tell Petra what your colleague asked.
cues: Say what the colleague asked about the meeting
b1-27-02.target: A kollégám azt kérdezte, hogy elmegyek-e a megbeszélésre.
b1-27-02.english: My colleague asked whether I am going to the meeting.
b1-27-02.canDo: I can report a question, with azt kérdezte, hogy … -e.

b1-27-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Keeping a Secret
b1-27-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg what she told Anna about the secret. You (Meg) say that you asked Anna not to tell anyone the secret.
b1-27-03.prompt: Tell Károly what you asked Anna to do.
cues: Say what she must not tell anyone
b1-27-03.target: Arra kértem Annát, hogy ne mondja el senkinek a titkot.
b1-27-03.english: I asked Anna not to tell anyone the secret.
b1-27-03.canDo: I can report a request or a command, with arra kért, hogy … + subjunctive.

b1-27-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Good Friends
b1-27-04.scenario: Petra asks Meg what makes a good friendship. You (Meg) say that good friends stand up for each other and stay faithful to each other.
b1-27-04.prompt: Tell Petra what good friends do for each other.
cues: Say that good friends stand up for each other
Say that they stay faithful to each other
b1-27-04.target: A jó barátok kiállnak egymásért. Hűek maradnak egymáshoz.
b1-27-04.english: Good friends stand up for each other. They stay faithful to each other.
b1-27-04.canDo: I can say that people do something for each other, with egymás in its case forms.

b1-27-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Going Anyway
b1-27-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg why she went to the meeting yesterday. You (Meg) say that although you were tired, you went to the meeting anyway.
b1-27-05.prompt: Tell Károly what you did in spite of being tired.
cues: Say that you went to the meeting anyway
b1-27-05.target: Bár fáradt voltam, mégis elmentem a találkozóra.
b1-27-05.english: Although I was tired, I went to the meeting anyway.
b1-27-05.canDo: I can say that something happened in spite of an obstacle, with bár, noha and annak ellenére, hogy.

b1-27-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Nemecsek and Áts Feri
b1-27-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri in the story. You (Meg) say that Nemecsek said he stays with his friends and does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Nemecsek said to Áts Feri.
cues: Say what Nemecsek told Áts Feri
Say that he does not go away
b1-27-consolidation.target: Nemecsek azt mondta Áts Ferinek, hogy a barátaival marad. Nem megy el.
b1-27-consolidation.english: Nemecsek told Áts Feri that he stays with his friends. He does not go away.
b1-27-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a boy who stays faithful to his friends, in a few sentences.
